description: Assembly source code implementing AES encryption/decryption routines optimized for ARMv8-A architecture, including key setup, encryption, decryption, CBC, and CTR modes, generated from BoringSSL's Perl script.

methods.name: aes_hw_set_encrypt_key
methods.description: Sets up the encryption key schedule for AES on ARMv8-A.

methods.name: aes_hw_set_decrypt_key
methods.description: Sets up the decryption key schedule for AES on ARMv8-A.

methods.name: aes_hw_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES encryption on data blocks using precomputed key schedule.

methods.name: aes_hw_decrypt
methods.description: Performs AES decryption on data blocks using precomputed key schedule.

methods.name: aes_hw_ctr32_encrypt_blocks
methods.description: Performs AES CTR mode encryption on multiple blocks.
